leads: They sealed the town. One gate still opens: the service gate, {side} side.
The service gate is on the {side} side, where the road meets the wall.
Gate motor: fuse blown, generator seized, tank dry.
Sgt. {sergeant} has the gate key. He walks {street}.
Gate fuses are kept at the hardware store, in the stock room cabinet.
It can be freed with tools and patience.

readables.fridge_note: Radio says they sealed the town. The service gate on the {side} side still opens. We go tonight.
readables.wall_map: A town map. The service gate on the {side} side is circled in red.
readables.duty_board: Gate detail. Key held by Sgt. {sergeant}. Off post since day 3.
readables.log_book: Motor dead. Fuse blown, generator seized, tank dry. Sgt. {sergeant} took the key when he went to find his kid. {street}.
readables.order_book: Gate fuses, two. Stock room, locked cabinet.
readables.garage_note: Gate fuse went back to the hardware store. Stock room.
readables.manual: Seized generator: work the flywheel loose with tools, an hour at a time. It can be freed with tools and patience.

broadcast: This is a recorded message for the town.
The town is under quarantine. Stay away from the wall.
One gate still opens: the service gate, {side} side.
